findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Observed several cans on the shelves to be dented. The dented cans were removed from the shelves by the inspector and set aside by the PIC. The inspector suggests increasing the frequency that employees check the condition of product. Employees should also be educated on the importance of removing dented cans from service. Ensure that food packages are always in good condition to protect food from potential contaminants.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed multiple foods (including, but not limited to, cookies and crackers) stored in baskets directly on the floor. The PIC was educated that food must be stored at least 6-inches above the floor. Ensure that the food is moved 6-inches above the ground by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed there is a buildup of ice on the condenser and product underneath the condenser in the back walk-in freezer. The buildup may be due to the large volume of product inside the freezer. Ensure that the buildup of ice is removed to create a smooth, easily cleanable surface by the next routine inspection. 

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.
